cohort: The cohort consisted of 125 patients admitted to the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of Sf. Pantelimon Hospital in Bucharest, Romania, between August 2024 and February 2025.
finding: Comprehensive prenatal care significantly reduced maternal antepartum and postpartum anemia, increased postpartum hemoglobin levels, shortened newborn hospital stays, and ultimately enhanced maternal and neonatal prognoses, leading to a significant reduction in maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality.
